content.text:
Four screens of the same table. My eyes hurt. "הפניקס" I know. "אלטשולר שחם" I've heard of.
I stop here. I won't open the rest.

input.answer: I didn't decide anything, and I'm not putting money in from this page. If anything here is close to a deposit it's the "כספי (שקלי)" track: about 4.4 to 4.6% at הראל, מיטב and אלטשולר שחם, with yearly fees of about 0.6 to 0.7% "מהחיסכון". But I'm not sure it's really as safe as a deposit or what those percentages mean, so I'll ask you or the bank first.
